jobs.occupation: We are looking for an Experienced Hardware Lead Engineer!
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about high-performance electronics, embedded systems, and cutting-edge engine technology? Join our client’s innovative engineering team where your expertise in hardware design will directly impact next-generation technology. Apply today, as we review applications on an ongoing basis!
About the role
Our client is a specialist and market leader in advanced electronic engine management systems, Vessel/Vehicle control systems and Power distribution modules. They develop the hardware and software that optimizes performance, reduces fuel consumption, and lowers emissions for everything from marine and automotive applications to industrial engines running on renewable fuels and next- generation hybrid/electric systems with a legacy of high-octane motorsport.
As a Hardware Engineer, you will play an important role creating next-generation Electronic Control Units (ECUs). You will join a collaborative, highly technical engineering team where your work has a direct impact. Your market will be truly global, supporting customers across the EU, US, India, and the UK from initial specification all the way to mass production.
Work tasks
In this role, you will own the hardware development lifecycle. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality products on time and within scope. Your main responsibilities will include:
Group Lead: Work with daily planning and cost estimations and follow up of deliverables.
HW System Engineering: Designing an efficient System/ ECU layout to reaach safety, Performance and cost demands. This includes understanding the ECU outside environment and Performance requirements.
Future Concept: Define Next generation HW module solutions.
End-to-End Hardware Design: Developing specifications, schematics, component configurations, and PCB designs for advanced ECUs.
Documentation & Strategy: Creating Bill of Materials (BOM) and documented design strategies, including hardware design descriptions and precise calculations.
Design Verification: Ensuring technical excellence through rigorous testing and verification phases.
Customer Collaboration: Acting as a technical bridge for clients worldwide. This includes understanding their needs, supporting them from prototyping to certification, and occasionally traveling to client sites to help implement the products firsthand.

We are looking for
A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a similar field
A few years of experience in Hardware Engineering – preferably within a company in the automotive industry
Previous experience as a group Lead – daily planning and follow up of deliverables
Solid knowledge of embedded systems hardware
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken

It is meritorious if you have experience in:
Power electronics development
Emotor control
Unmanned Vessels/Vehicles
Low level software: HardWare InterFace (HWIF) and eTPU coding
Establishing and maintaining customer relations

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Are you a student or recent graduate looking to gain international experience, develop high-demand skills, and create a lasting social impact?
BøthOfUs is seeking passionate international interns—including those applying through the Erasmus+ program—to join our multicultural team in Stockholm, Sweden.
Vacancies: 2 positions available
Location: Stockholm, Sweden (On-site/Hybrid)
Target Audience: Current students and recent graduates

📂 Available Roles
Select the path that best aligns with your goals and skills:
Market Research & Innovation
Conduct market and user research to guide project directions.
Perform stakeholder interviews and synthesize data.
Contribute directly to new product development, service design, and international campaigns.

Managerial Assistant

🌟 Who We Are Looking For
Impact-Driven Mindset: Candidates who are deeply committed to social impact creation.

Founded in 2017 in Stockholm, BøthOfUs builds digital tools and drives international innovation projects alongside global institutions like the UN and the EU. We empower startups, SMEs, and coworking hubs through digital transformation, and we co-create global soft-landing initiatives spanning the EU, Africa, Latin America, and Japan.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced and confident Project Manager is required for a consulting assignment focused on establishing a receiving organisation for long-term service management and continued development following a major transformation programme. The programme involves significant changes to system support, processes and ways of working.
A feasibility study has mapped deliveries, systems, processes and existing management structures. The Project Manager will take ownership of its outcomes, prioritise identified gaps, and translate recommendations into a concrete, practical and executable implementation plan.
The role focuses on organisational establishment, business transformation and the transition from a programme structure to a line organisation. The assignment requires the creation of clear accountability, mandates and process ownership, ensuring that the appropriate capabilities, resources, governance and service-management processes are in place before handover.
Key Responsibilities
Take over and assess the results of the feasibility study, including mapped deliveries, systems, processes and existing management structures.
Prioritise organisational, operational and technical gaps and convert recommendations into an actionable delivery and implementation plan.
Establish a receiving organisation capable of supporting long-term management and continued development after programme completion.
Define responsibilities, decision-making mandates, process ownership and organisational interfaces for the future operating model.
Ensure that required competencies, resources, governance structures and service-management processes are established ahead of the handover.
Lead cross-functional change initiatives involving business stakeholders, IT, service management, service desk functions, programme management and external suppliers.
Manage dependencies, drive decisions and create progress within a complex organisation where responsibilities and organisational interfaces are still being defined.
Balance organisational and technical requirements against business value, cost, resource needs and long-term sustainability.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Strong experience in Project Management for business development, IT, transformation and organisational change initiatives.
Experience with ITIL or other established IT Service Management frameworks.
Ability to establish governance models, operating structures, process ownership and service-management capabilities.
Experience translating feasibility studies, assessments and mapping activities into decisions, implementation plans and operational execution.
Understanding of the interaction between business operations, IT, service management, service desk functions and external suppliers.
Experience managing cross-functional dependencies and organisational transition activities in large, complex environments.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate has documented senior-level experience in project management within business development, IT, transformation and organisational change. Previous experience establishing receiving organisations, service-management organisations or equivalent structures in large and complex enterprises is required. The candidate should be able to turn analysis and identified needs into effective organisational structures, governance and working methods, while driving alignment and progress in environments with unclear or evolving responsibilities and mandates.
Excellent written and spoken Swedish and good written and spoken English are required.

jobs.occupation: SAP S/4HANA Workstream Lead  Source to Pay (S2P)
jobs.description:
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Workstream Lead – Source to Pay (S2P) for a major SAP S/4HANA transformation programme within an international organisation.
This is an exciting opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of a critical workstream in a large-scale greenfield ERP implementation. Following a successful pilot, the programme is expanding across multiple sites in Europe and North America, creating opportunities to shape harmonised processes and drive business transformation at scale.
📍 Location: Solna, Sweden
🏢 Work model: Hybrid – approximately 3 days per week on-site
📅 Assignment period: Until December 2027, with a possibility of extension
🕒 Workload: Full-time
✈️ Travel: Occasional travel to client sites in Sweden, Finland and the US
🎯 About the Role
As Workstream Lead for Source to Pay, you will have overall responsibility for planning, coordinating and delivering the S2P workstream within a complex SAP S/4HANA greenfield implementation.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, implementation partners and programme leadership to ensure that processes, systems and data are aligned across the organisation.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end S2P workstream delivery, ensuring progress against scope, timelines, budget and quality targets.
Manage risks, issues, dependencies and cross-workstream coordination.
Develop efficient, standardised and sustainable S2P processes supported by SAP S/4HANA, SAP Sourcing, SAP Ariba and connected systems.
Coordinate business stakeholders, IT teams, implementation partners and other programme workstreams.
Drive the resolution of process, data and system gaps in collaboration with business and technical teams.
Coordinate workstream resources, responsibilities, governance and ways of working.
Maintain stakeholder engagement, alignment and clear expectations throughout the programme.
Report progress, risks and key decisions to the Global Process Owner for S2P and programme management.
Skills
SAP
HANA

Skills & requirements
✅ Required Skills & Experience
Strong hands-on experience with both SAP Sourcing and SAP Ariba implementations – both are mandatory.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA, preferably within large-scale transformation or implementation programmes.
Proven experience leading projects or workstreams within Source to Pay (S2P).
Experience driving process harmonisation across complex, international organisations.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, bridging business and technical teams.
Ability to manage competing priorities, dependencies and delivery risks in a complex programme environment.
A structured, collaborative and hands-on leadership approach.
Professional fluency in English.
⭐ Preferred Qualifications
Experience in manufacturing or other complex, multinational industrial environments.
Familiarity with global ERP rollouts across multiple geographical locations.
Swedish language skills.
🌍 Why This Opportunity?
Take ownership of a strategic workstream within a major global ERP transformation.
Contribute to the rollout of a successful SAP S/4HANA greenfield solution.
Work at the intersection of procurement, business processes, technology and organisational change.
Collaborate with international teams across Europe and North America.
📩 Interested in this opportunity?
If you have successfully led S2P workstreams and have implementation experience with both SAP Sourcing and SAP Ariba, we would like to hear from you.
Please send your updated CV highlighting your relevant SAP implementation experience, S2P leadership responsibilities and availability.

Are you a supportive leader with a passion for process improvement and team development? 
About the role
Over the last five years, Akind Finance has transitioned into a centralized function. Today, we support operations across Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, Germany, and from 2027, Switzerland. Our portfolio of brands includes Academic Work, Winona, Brights, and Crowd Collective. During this journey, we have modernized our systems and successfully consolidated our Credit Management, Customer Invoicing, and Supplier Invoices teams into one unified AP/AR team.
As our new Group AP/AR Manager, you will report to the Group Finance Director and lead a team of AP/AR specialists, administrators, and finance assistants from our office in Linköping. As our AP/AR function enters its next chapter, your most critical task will be to provide supportive leadership that cultivates a strong foundation of trust and psychological safety, while actively driving continuous process improvements and optimization across our financial workflows. You will also be a key member of the Finance Management Team, contributing to strategic alignment and cross-functional collaboration.
Work tasks
You will hold the overall responsibility for all financial flows related to client and supplier payments.
You will provide visible, accessible leadership through regular dialogue, coaching, constructive feedback, and cross-training.
You will drive process improvements by continuously streamlining, standardizing, harmonizing, and automating our AP/AR end-to-end processes.
You will continuously streamline, standardize, and automate the AP/AR processes.
You will ensure accurate client and supplier invoicing and payments according to agreed terms.
You will deliver responsive, professional support to internal stakeholders, customers, and consultants while improving handovers.
You will establish and track relevant KPIs, goals, and targets within the AP/AR processes.

We are looking for
To succeed in this role, you are a confident, approachable, and low-ego leader. You create trust through presence, clarity, and consistent follow-through. You communicate openly, address challenges directly, and help people understand both what needs to change and why. Above all, you enjoy developing people and building a team that shares knowledge and supports one another. You also naturally align with our core values: Show Heart, Share Energy, and Beat Yesterday.  
Required experience & background:
You have proven people leadership experience, including direct responsibility for a team, coaching, performance follow-up, and competence development.
You have a sound operational understanding of financial flows and experience from AP, AR, Invoicing, Credit Management, or a related transaction-intensive function.
You have demonstrated the ability to improve ways of working while involving employees and protecting the quality of daily delivery.
You have strong communication skills and professional fluency in English and Swedish.

Meritorious experience:
A degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related discipline.
Background in a complex, multi-company, or international organization.
Practical experience with automation, digitalization, system implementation, or AI-supported process improvement.
Additional language skills, particularly Finnish, German, or French.

Practical Information In this recruitment process, Akind is working together with Winona. If you have any questions, please contact Researcher Liisa Ehrenborg Unenge ++liisa.unenge@winonagroup.com++ or Consultant Sandra Isojärvi ++sandra.isojarvi@winonagroup.com++. We look forward to receiving your application!

The opportunity
As a Real Estate Facility Manager with us, you are responsible for managing both leased and owned premises and maintain daily contact with the operations that take place in these facilities. You have budget responsibility and ensure that maintenance plans are developed and implemented. You act as a requirements setter in construction projects and coordinate property-related matters. You collaborate with business units and support functions, taking overall responsibility for understanding current and future needs.
How you’ll make an impact
Budget responsibility and follow-up for the different sites
Act as the primary contact between Hitachi and property owners as well as their subcontractors
Place orders for assignments in collaboration with both internal and external colleagues
Plan and monitor both preventive and corrective maintenance as well as various construction projects
Ensure compliance with applicable directives, regulatory requirements, and laws
Financial follow-up and evaluation of signed agreements
Operational and personnel responsibility for the daily activities within the property management unit

Relevant education and extensive experience in property management for commercial and industrial facilities
Minimum 10 years in similar roles, including personnel responsibility
Strong negotiation, communication, and leadership skills; proven ability to manage projects and maintenance budgets
Expertise in project management, reporting, and developing maintenance plans
Solid knowledge of tenancy and contract law, as well as regulatory compliance
Structured and detail-oriented approach with excellent documentation skills
Proficiency in Swedish and English, both spoken and written; driver’s license required

jobs.occupation: Advance Your Career as a Consultant Pathologist in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in pathology looking for a role where you can combine advanced diagnostics with a balanced lifestyle?
We are currently seeking specialist surgical pathologists to join a modern and accredited department in central Sweden, located in a region known for its coastal setting, rich history, and strong connection to nature.
About the Department
The surgical pathology and cytology unit plays a central role in diagnostics by analyzing tissue and cell samples using both microscopy and advanced digital systems. The goal is to provide accurate and timely diagnostic support to clinicians, improving patient outcomes and safety.
The department is part of a larger organization within laboratory medicine and is at the forefront of digital pathology, with ongoing development in automation, robotics, and AI-driven diagnostics.
In addition to histopathology and cytology, the unit is also responsible for:
Gynecological screening programs
Autopsy services and morgue operations
Multidisciplinary clinical conferences
You will work in a collaborative and well-structured environment with experienced colleagues across multiple disciplines.
Your role
As a specialist surgical pathologist, your work will include:
Diagnostic work in histopathology and cytology
Gross examination and specimen handling
Participation in clinical conferences and interdisciplinary discussions
Autopsy
Supervising and mentoring residents

Daytime on-call service for urgent diagnostic cases is shared within the team.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in pathology
Experience in surgical pathology
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-based environment
A structured, collaborative, and flexible approach

Why work here?
This opportunity is located in a coastal region of central Sweden, offering a unique mix of professional development and quality of life. The area is known for:
Easy access to the sea, forests, and outdoor activities year-round
A rich industrial and cultural heritage
A safe and family-friendly environment
Good infrastructure with connections to larger cities
The working environment is modern, forward-thinking, and continuously evolving, providing excellent conditions for both professional growth and long-term career development.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype
Take the next step in your career
This is an excellent opportunity for surgical pathologists who want to work in a progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.
Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?
Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.
Apply now!

jobs.occupation: Exciting Radiologist Position in the Heart of Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a board-certified radiologist looking for a new challenge in a beautiful part of Sweden?
This position combines professional development with a high quality of life in a scenic region known for its lakes, forests and outdoor lifestyle.
About the hospital and department
The radiology department is part of the Diagnostic Imaging and Functional Medicine division and performs around 24,000 examinations annually. The unit is equipped with two ultrasound machines, one MRI, one CT scanner and two conventional X-ray systems (one with fluoroscopy). Both acute and planned diagnostic services are provided in modern facilities with continuously updated technology.
You will join a skilled and stable team of radiologists, radiographers, nurses and administrative staff. Staff turnover among doctors has been close to zero in recent years. The department is also preparing for a major upgrade of both premises and equipment in the near future.
Tasks and responsibilities
Broad diagnostic radiology including conventional X-ray, ultrasound and CT.
Participation in both acute and planned care.
Collaboration with other clinical specialties.
On-call duties are possible but not mandatory (primarily organised from a nearby hospital).

Requirements
Specialist certification in radiology from an EU/EEA country, recognised by EU directive 2005/36/EC.
Several years of clinical experience preferred, but not mandatory.
Skills in ultrasound and CT required; fluoroscopy and interventional procedures are a plus.
Good command of English. Willingness to learn Swedish to minimum B2/C1 level (language training provided).

Personal profile
Cooperative and a team player, while able to work independently.
Flexible and adaptable in a changing clinical environment.
Service-minded and attentive in patient interaction.
Proactive and quality-focused.

Terms and conditions
Full-time, Monday–Friday, daytime hours.
Competitive salary
Permanent employment in the Swedish public healthcare system.
Relocation package and intensive Swedish language training included.

Why this location?
The hospital is located in the heart of Hälsingland, a region offering a unique combination of professional challenges and an exceptional quality of life. Here you will find affordable housing, short commutes, and endless opportunities for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing, and fishing – all within reach of a modern healthcare environment.
Application process
Please send a complete application including:
CV and cover letter
Diplomas and specialist certificate
Employment references
Information on your availability to start language training and relocation

EU/EEA candidates only. Swedish medical license and specialist recognition from the National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen) are required before independent practice. Support will be provided throughout this process.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Swedish Speaking Online Content Moderator/Customer Support Agent

moderation solutions to leading online marketplaces, dating sites, and sharing economy services. 
Our automation tool, Implio, facilitates fast and easy moderation, often in combination with our 
manual services.  Besedo is a very multicultural company, and it shows through our employees, 
who between them, boast a range of 17 different languages. Besedo is a fast-growing tech
company providing tools and services to online marketplaces around the world. 
At Besedo, our moderation teams are at the core of our business and essential to our success.

Join a vibrant, international team in Malta, dedicated to making the internet a safer place for all!

-Supporting users and answer their questions via email

Klättermusen is looking for an Accounting Manager
Since 1975 Klättermusen has been a pioneer in making refined Scandinavian Mountaineering Equipment. The designs combine utility and extreme durability, always with consideration of the environment in mind. Klättermusen supports and inspire outdoor enthusiasts through unforgiving weather conditions and unpredictable terrains. Rigorously tested in real-world conditions, the equipment embodies Klättermusen’s commitment to creating the best and most sustainable equipment available.
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Accounting Manager to lead Klättermusen’s accounting operations and further develop the financial processes supporting our international business.

The role has overall responsibility for accurate, timely and compliant accounting across the Group’s legal entities and combines operational accounting expertise with team leadership and process ownership. The Accounting Manager works closely with our CFO, Financial Controller and accounting team members. The position is based at our headquarters in Åre and reports to the CFO.

Responsibilities

Lead and coordinate day-to-day accounting across Klättermusen’s legal entities.

Lead, support and develop the accounting team and allocate daily priorities and responsibilities.

Own the monthly and annual accounting reconciliation and consolidation closing process.

Coordinate inter company accounting, reconciliations, settlements as well as TP adjustments based on policy in place.

Coordinate VAT, employer, tax and other statutory financial reporting in relevant jurisdictions.

Coordinate preparation of statutory annual accounts and supporting documentation.

Act as a key finance contact for auditors and external accounting, tax and payroll partners.

Own and secure our internal controls, approval processes and accounting documentation.

Drive standardisation, automation and continuous improvement of accounting processes.

Support effective use and development of Business Central and related finance systems.

Support implementation of accounting structures for new legal entities, channels and markets.

Work closely with the Financial Controller to provide high-quality input to Group reporting.

Support the CFO with accounting matters, financial controls and finance projects

Qualifications

Relevant degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or equivalent professional experience.

At least five years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in an international or multi-entity environment.

Strong knowledge of financial accounting, reconciliations, closing processes and statutory reporting.

Experience coordinating VAT, tax and other regulatory financial reporting.

Strong ERP and Excel skills; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is advantageous.

Professional working proficiency in English and Swedish.

Structured, hands-on and comfortable managing several entities and deadlines simultaneously.

High level of integrity, accuracy, ownership and professional judgement.

Collaborative and able to work across countries, functions and organisational levels

What Klättermusen offers

A forward-thinking design environment in a global outdoor brand

Close collaboration with international production, sourcing teams, and testing environments

Opportunities for creative impact and professional growth

A workplace immersed in the outdoors — Åre is both our home and our testing ground.

The position is full time position based in Åre. Welcome to apply by January 13th, 2026.

jobs.occupation: We are looking for a C#.NET developer!
jobs.description:
Join a high-performance engineering environment where you will tackle complex logic and massive datasets. Our client leverages custom database structures and heavy algorithms to drive innovation in scalable backend architecture. Apply today as we use ongoing selection.
About the role
Our client is a well-established, technology-driven organization where deep engineering is at the heart of what they build. From a proprietary search engine to advanced cybersecurity solutions, their products are built to handle massive amounts of data and deliver actionable insights in real time.  Their R&D, engineering, and data centers are located in Sweden, headquarters in London, and teams across the US, the company operates on a truly global scale.
Together with our client, we are looking for a motivated C# .NET Developer to join their core engine team, currently consisting of four developers. Here, you will work on the systems that power the platform’s high-volume, near-real-time data processing. You will design and develop scalable backend services and APIs, working closely with data ingestion, search, and indexing technologies. Performance, reliability, scalability, and clean architecture are central to the role, and you will have a real opportunity to influence technical decisions as the platform continues to evolve. You will work in an agile and highly collaborative environment alongside experienced engineers. Most importantly, your work will have a direct impact: the systems you build will help security teams around the world detect and act on critical cyber intelligence.
Work tasks
Design and implement distributed and scalable backend solutions using C# .NET.  
Manage and process large datasets through efficient data pipelines.  
Own the performance and health of our databases and data structures.  
Maintain and evolve the company's proprietary in-house database structures and search engines.  
Build and optimize robust integrations between diverse systems and data sources.  
Leverage modern AI tools in your daily workflow as part of the company-wide AI-first mindset.  
Maintain and optimize existing codebase while actively driving new feature development and modernization initiatives.  
Move between fast-paced integration work and deeper architectural design as the platform evolves.

We are looking for
Platform/support mindset, self-directedness, or production ownership
A couple years experience and advanced knowledge of C# .NET development.
Good knowledge of databases SQL and/or postgres, search engines such as ElasticSearch.
Pragmatic approach to AI with an eagerness to adopt AI-assisted development tools.
Previous experience with one or more of Crawlers, Indexing or Search and Information Retrieval.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

It is meritorious if you have experience in Python.
 
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

The opportunity 
At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We power homes, schools, hospitals, and in-dustries while creating solutions that support people and the environment.
As part of our growing Cooling Systems business in Landskrona, Hitachi Energy is looking for a Production Engineer with a focus on Digitalization to join our team. You will work in a global organization that develops and manufactures reliable water-cooling systems for critical applications. We value teamwork, diversity, continuous learning, and innova-tion.
Your Responsibilities
Drive digitalization and automation initiatives within production and logistics to improve performance.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs to support data-driven decisions.
Collect, analyze, and visualize data to identify improvement opportunities and enable fact-based decisions.
Drive the adoption and utilization of AI across factory operations to improve performance.
Support integration between production systems, ERP solutions, and other digital platforms.
Lead or contribute to projects related to MES, WMS, Industry 4.0, and continuous improvement.
Promote Lean ways of working and support process optimization across the organization.
Collaborate with colleagues across functions to implement sustainable and efficient solutions.

Your Background
Degree in Engineering or a related field, with experience from manufacturing or production environments.
Experience with databases, SQL, ERP systems (such as SAP), and programming.
Knowledge of data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or similar platforms.
Ability to manage projects and drive improvements independently.
Great analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Collaborative and inclusive mindset, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.
Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our ben-efits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By priori-tizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Want to take new light technology from the lab out into the world?
About us
LunaLEC is a Swedish deep tech company that has mastered printed light. Just like text on a newspaper, the light-emitting structure is printed, forming a thin, patterned, flexible device. The light-emitting electrochemical cell (LEC) technology is built on 30 years of research, during which the team behind LunaLEC became the first in the world to fully print a light source. The technology is protected by several patents.
We are now taking the LEC technology from the lab to large-scale roll-to-roll production. This is your opportunity to be part of it from the start and build something significant, as well as working with technology that is not yet on the market. It is a pivotal stage for the company, and you could get the chance to lead it.
About the role
As Process Engineer, you will be the one who takes our process from the lab to industry. You will transfer today's sheet-to-sheet manufacturing to roll-to-roll and build the network of partners who will handle production, from substrates and printing to lamination and quality control. You will work closely with a team with deep expertise in the materials and the technology, while contributing with your experience in production. The role is new, and you will have a strong say in how it takes shape.
Your responsibilities will include:
Leading and owning the scale-up of our production from sheet-to-sheet to roll-to-roll
Implementing and optimising our processes in production environments with partners and in existing facilities
Leading the collaboration with our production partners and taking part in customer and partner demos as well as EU projects
Being responsible for quality, routines and compliance in production
Travelling internationally to implement and follow up production on site

We believe that you…
…hold a Master of Science in Engineering, for example in materials engineering, chemical engineering or physics. You have experience of production, roll-to-roll and process development. Experience of scaling a production process, solution based device fabrication at scale and printed electronics are merits. You communicate fluently in English.
As a person, you are driven, solution-oriented and enjoy taking responsibility. You take ownership of your areas and have a business-oriented mindset. Above all, you want to help build something new and see a unique technology reach the market.
We offer
🚀 The opportunity to become a valued part of a deep tech company on its way out into the world
💡 Plenty of room to make an impact and build a completely new function from the ground up
🌍 An international and dedicated team
✈️ International assignments and close collaboration with customers and partners
About the position
Employment type: Permanent (with an initial 6-month probationary period)
Start: By agreement
Scope: Full-time
Location: Umeå preferred, but remote work with regular visits to Umeå is possible. International travel is part of the role

Read more about us at www.lunalec.com

About us
Areta Group is a growing Nordic corporate services firm supporting international companies, investors and professional clients with accounting, governance and corporate administration across the Nordic region.
We are building a lean, high-quality team and are now looking for a Junior Accountant / Redovisningsekonom to support our growing client portfolio.
The role
You will work across several companies and support a variety of accounting and administrative tasks for our international client entities.
The role will include day-to-day accounting work, client coordination and support with reporting, reconciliations, filings and year-end processes. As your experience grows, you will have the opportunity to take on broader and more complex assignments.
Main responsibilities
Ongoing bookkeeping and accounting
Accounts payable and accounts receivable
Bank reconciliations and other account reconciliations
Preparation of payment files and supporting documentation
Supporting VAT, employer and other recurring reporting
Supporting monthly and year-end closing
Preparing accounting files and documentation for clients, auditors and other advisers
Assisting with annual reports and tax-related work
Supporting the setup of accounting and reporting for new client entities
Maintaining accurate accounting records, client files and supporting documentation
Collecting and coordinating information from clients and third parties
Supporting invoicing, payment administration and other practical client-related tasks
Assisting with other accounting and administrative assignments as needed

What we are looking for
You should have:
Education in accounting, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken, are required
Good general IT skills and confidence working with Excel
Comfortable working in accounting systems such as Fortnox, Visma or similar
Strong attention to detail and a structured way of working
A client-first mindset and a professional, service-oriented approach
Good communication skills and care in client relationships
Ability to manage several tasks and work to deadlines
Flexibility and willingness to learn as the role and company develop

Accounting experience is an advantage, but we are also open to candidates earlier in their career who have the right foundation and attitude.
Nice to have
Experience working with international clients or companies
Experience with listed companies
Experience with monthly or annual closing
Experience working with auditors
Experience with more than one accounting or ERP system

What we offer
This is an opportunity to join a growing company and develop together with the business.
You will gain exposure to different clients, industries and types of accounting work, with room to broaden your experience over time.

You should be comfortable working both remotely and from the office
